title: AI build plan card: draw a generated record title (「名称：自动生成「{图书} · {读者} · {借出日期}」，表单里不出现」) from the plan card's new `nameField.generated` key
body:
Filed by the `repo:cloud#2` seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#24145, session `session_01Cbdek8SKSHxddGqTPZXdqX`) from the objectstack-ai/cloud#2925 dev report (cloud PR #3047, report `6256739687`), out-of-scope finding 3: a dependent single on cloud's producer half, the same shape as objectstack-ai/objectui#12994. ⛔ Not a claim.

Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/cloud#3047

## The producer (cloud#2925, PR #3047)

cloud's plan card now carries `planCard.objects[].nameField.generated = { template, line }` when an object's record title is a formula the user never types. A relation object (借阅记录) has `line` 「名称：自动生成「{图书} · {读者} · {借出日期}」，表单里不出现」, as the AiBuild artboard draws it.
- The title field is then left out of the object's field chips; the line stands for it.
- Source: `packages/service-ai-studio/src/build-cards.ts`, with `schema/build-cards.schema.json` regenerated.

## The gap (objectui `43efd078`, per the dev report)

`liftPlanCard` lifts `nameField` as `{ name, label }` only, and the vendored `build-cards.schema.json` lacks `generated`. So the console draws 「名称：借阅标题」.

## Target

- The plan card draws `nameField.generated.line` when it is present, in place of the plain 「名称：<label>」 line.
- `liftPlanCard` lifts `generated`, and the vendored schema carries it.
- An object without the key draws as today.

## Acceptance

A test: a plan-card object whose `nameField` carries `generated` draws its line, and one without it is unchanged.

## Dedupe

Searched for: `plan card nameField generated`, `liftPlanCard nameField`, `PlanCardObjectRows name line`.
